title: Violation Points Loading on the Switch Down Payment — Installment Payment Plans
content:
| Company violation points on the Owner Auto Policy term billed | Added to the switch down payment percentage |
|---|---|
| 8 or more | 5 |
| 4 to 7 | 2.5 |
| 3 or fewer | nothing |

Applies under the **Installment Payment Plans** when a plan billing an Owner Auto Policy term is moved off automatic draft to the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan. The points are those recorded on the Owner Auto Policy term the plan bills.

*Hypothetical.* A term carrying 4 points adds 2.5 percentage points; 3 points adds nothing; 8 points adds 5.
